how: Drop-in and course yoga classes run at studios such as Yogi Yoga in Ritan Park, Chaoyang, with several other studios listed in the expat directory.
Pilates and Gyrokinesis sessions are offered at studios such as Iso Fit in Chaoyang, and Alona Pilates Studio has run mat classes since 2005.
No outdoor ski slope lies within about 30 km of the centre; the nearest resorts are Nanshan (Miyun, roughly 62 km), Yunfoshan and Yuyang (about 60 km), with the Chongli resorts around 250 km away.
Geothermal hot spring bathing in indoor and outdoor pools is available at Longmai Hot Spring Resort in Xiaotangshan, Changping, a half-day trip from the city.
HeyRunning and other groups hold weekly group runs, including a free monthly 5k and regular sessions at Chaoyang Park, and a Hash House Harriers chapter runs on Sundays.
No drive-through safari lies within about 30 km; Beijing Wildlife Park in Daxing has a self-drive safari section but is roughly 42 km from the centre, about an hour's drive.
Beijing Poker Club organises sanctioned Texas Hold'em tournaments, but cash games are restricted and expat home games are informal; sources are dated.
Trail riding exists in the western hills (for example Beishan trails, Changping) and group rides such as Serk's depart from the city; trail listings are on MTB Project.
A tethered hot air balloon ride (about 50 m up for ten minutes) has operated at Beijing Expo Garden in Fengtai; free-flight balloon rides are only in Yanqing, far outside the metro area.
Mu Ben Mu Gong Fang is a woodworking studio in eastern Beijing where visitors build wooden objects and simple instruments.
venue: Mu Ben Mu Gong Fang (木本木工坊)

how: The Beijing Union Symphony Orchestra recruits musicians and the Starry Sky Orchestra is an open amateur ensemble.
Beijing Improv runs weekly improvisational theatre workshops in English, with no full acting school confirmed.
BLCU Continuing Education College runs evening and weekend tai chi courses (24-form, Chen and Wu styles, sword) and private schools such as Black Tiger Club and Jinghua Wushu teach in Chaoyang.
venue: BLCU Continuing Education College Taichi training

how: The Alliance Francaise de Beijing, a non-profit French school founded in 1998 with Beijing Language and Culture University, teaches French language courses.
Private dog and cat shelters in Shunyi and Tongzhou, such as Hui's Sanctuary, run volunteer days that welcome expats; most coordination is by WeChat.
Expat volunteers can join animal rescue volunteer days in Shunyi and Tongzhou and other community groups, organised mostly through WeChat.
Beijing Fablab in Zhongguancun offers 3D printing alongside CNC milling, laser processing and circuit making.
Beijing Fablab lists laser processing and vinyl cutting among its lab capabilities.
Beijing Fablab lists CNC milling and precision milling among its lab capabilities.
Beijing Fablab (circuit making, open to makers) and the Beijing Makerspace community (MAXPACE) support electronics tinkering; listings are dated.
Beijing Parkour Community and the Snow Fox Parkour Club have run indoor and outdoor training, and parks such as Ritan and Tiantan have calisthenics areas; sources date from 2009-2015.
Pedal boats can be hired by the hour at Beihai Park and around Houhai and Qianhai lakes from mid-March, with a deposit.
Foot and full-body massage parlours are in nearly every neighbourhood, with spa brands such as Liangzi Spa, Gin Spa and Bodhi Spa in Sanlitun.
The China National Post and Postage Stamp Museum in Dongcheng covers philatelic heritage, and philatelic companies and themed post offices sell commemorative stamps.
venue: China National Post and Postage Stamp Museum

how: Open English-language talks and book events are held at venues such as Yale Center Beijing in the IFC Building, Chaoyang.
Beijing's 2019 rules bar dog walking in city parks and require leashes, so no off-leash dog parks were found; the nearest pet activity areas are in Yanqing, about 75 km away.
University and school clubs such as the BUPT amateur radio club (BY1BY) operate club stations, and licensed hams in the BA1/BD1/BG1 prefix area are listed under the Chinese Radio Sports Association.
